summary: Adds a delta-scoped is_reasoning_end_streaming so the structured-output scheduler stops re-scanning the whole context once per request per decode step. The base engine plus every engine parser with a custom reasoning-end rule get overrides, and each delta-scoped variant provably agrees with its full-sequence is_reasoning_end under the precondition (reasoning still open at step start) that all call sites enforce. Clean, well-scoped, and thoroughly tested.
actions_taken: Read the diff and the surrounding code: vllm/parser/engine/parser_engine.py (base is_reasoning_end vs new is_reasoning_end_streaming), vllm/parser/engine/adapters.py (adapter materializes delta via list(), leaves input_ids un-materialized on the fast path), vllm/reasoning/abs_reasoning_parsers.py and vllm/parser/abstract_parser.py (default fallbacks), and vllm/v1/structured_output/__init__.py (should_advance, prepare_grammar_bitmask window loop, _find_reasoning_end_index).

Cross-model blast radius check: enumerated all ParserEngine subclasses (minimax_m2, deepseek_v32, deepseek_v4, mistral, kimi_k2, gemma4, inkling, qwen3, glm47_moe). Confirmed all six with a custom is_reasoning_end (mistral, kimi_k2, gemma4, inkling, qwen3, glm47_moe) received a matching streaming override, and the three without a custom is_reasoning_end correctly inherit the base delta-scoped version.

Verified streaming-vs-full parity for each override via position analysis: base/glm47_moe/kimi_k2/inkling/mistral each compute the same 'rightmost relevant marker in the suffix' result as their full is_reasoning_end (matching check order). Qwen3's merged loop with the tool_call open/close logic reduces to (last-end > last-start) OR (last-open-tool-call > last-start), identical to its two-pass full predicate, because the delta is always a suffix so 'tool_call_end after i within the delta' == 'within the full sequence'.

Confirmed the correctness precondition (method only invoked while reasoning is still open) holds at all three call sites: should_advance short-circuits on structured_req.reasoning_ended; the mid-window loop is gated by 'not apply_bitmask'; _find_reasoning_end_index scans from the delta-window start where reasoning was open. Empty-delta always falls back to the full predicate, so it is safe regardless.

Confirmed gemma4 deliberately keeps the full scan (its predicate defaults to True with no marker and <|turn>/<tool_response> flip meaning with _thinking_enabled) - no regression vs prior behavior, documented rationale is correct.
Ran: python -m pytest tests/parser/engine/ -q  -> 3746 passed (covers engine + all per-model configs).

Attempted tests/reasoning/ : one collection error is an unrelated missing optional package (cohere_melody); the remainder timed out because those tests download real tokenizers/models (network-bound), not related to this diff. Engine-level suites already cover the changed behavior.

Considered but dropped as non-findings: qwen3's inner any() is O(delta^2) but delta is the small per-step window (still O(step), which is the point of the PR, not O(context)); widened parameter type annotations (Sequence/Iterable vs list) in overrides are LSP-safe; the un-materialized itertools.islice delta from should_advance is materialized by the adapter before the engine sees it.
